messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] diff_manual.sh
parts:
On Monday, February 18, 2013 4:21:47 PM UTC-5, Bob Carpenter wrote:
n 2/18/13 4:07 PM, Daniel Lee wrote:
> Thanks, Bob. While we're on the topic of cleanup, I want to pull StanMode out of our src/ directory and put it in its
> own repo with Jeffrey Arnold and myself as contributors. I think that's a better permanent place for it.

That sounds good.

> diff_manual.sh -- I'll take a look and see if I can pull it into the makefile.

I think you'll still need the .sh somewhere, but maybe
that can go under src/script or something?

I think it would be fine to make a src/script directory and put stuff in it.

The main reason I wrote diff_manual.sh outside of the makefile is that diff_manual.sh takes two git arguments: the baseline and the place you want to diff from. So, you could in principle create a diffed manual from 1.1.0 relative to 1.0.

Ben
